summary: Frontend-only testing for Tanisha's macOS portfolio. Verified all 8 requested items: (1) Podcast Spotify card artwork + title now load real data from Spotify oembed (not placeholder). (2) Song card metadata matches destination URL (Mystery of Love / track 5GbVzc6Ex5LYlLJqzRQhuy). (3) About Me opens exactly 4 windows (portrait, aboutme.txt, spotify song, spotify podcast) with NO readinglist.txt / watchlist.txt windows. (4) Notes sidebar has exactly the 5 required notes; old cat-vet-dates / films-to-rewatch notes are gone. (5-8) Grocery, Books, Watch, Wishlist content all match spec including checkbox toggle behavior and section footers. All functional acceptance criteria met.
action_items: MINOR NAMING MISMATCH (non-blocking): Review request references data-testids `window-preview-about-portrait`, `window-textedit-aboutme`, `window-spotify-song`, `window-spotify-podcast`. Actual rendered testids are `preview-portrait.jpg`, `textedit-aboutme`, `spotify-song`, `spotify-podcast` (each Window has an explicit `testid` prop that overrides the fallback `window-${id}` naming in Window.jsx line 78). The windows DO exist and are functionally correct — this is only a testid naming inconsistency vs the review-request spec. Suggest either (a) prefixing the testid with `window-` in Desktop.jsx / SpotifyCard.jsx / preview & textedit wrappers, OR (b) updating the review-request spec to reflect the actual convention. Not a user-visible bug.

MINOR CDN SUBSTRING NOTE: Review request expected Spotify art src to contain `i.scdn.co`. Spotify oembed currently returns URLs on `image-cdn-ak.spotifycdn.com` / `image-cdn-fa.spotifycdn.com` (also official Spotify CDN, different subdomain). Functionally correct — real Spotify-hosted artwork is loading, not a placeholder. If strict `i.scdn.co` matching is required in downstream tests, relax the assertion to `spotifycdn.com`.
critical_code_review_comments: SpotifyCard.jsx correctly uses Spotify oembed as single source of truth for title + art, matches the destination URL — bug is properly fixed.
Desktop.jsx ABOUT_ME_LAYOUT correctly contains exactly 4 entries (preview-about-portrait, textedit-aboutme, spotify-song, spotify-podcast) — restructure is complete.
notes.js has clean 5-note array (2am, grocery, books, watch, wishlist) with correct content; no orphan legacy notes.

Non-blocking: The testid naming convention across Window children is inconsistent (some pass explicit testid overriding default window-${id}). Consider standardising to always include the `window-` prefix for the root Window element to make automated testing selectors predictable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 8 acceptance criteria pass functionally; 2 minor naming notes documented)
